pnpm exec turbo run test --filter=@bb/app -- src/components/control-plane
verification.dockerCommand: BB_CONTROL_PLANE_BROWSER_ARTIFACTS="$BB_THREAD_STORAGE/p5-webhooks-browser" BB_TEST_BROWSER_CHANNEL=chrome caffeinate -i pnpm exec turbo run test:control-plane-deployment --filter=@bb/server --env-mode=loose -- --browser-only
notes: The lost-reply fixture changes only the delivery acknowledgement to pending after native admission; redelivery after restart retains the original native run identity.
Desktop and 390px mobile webhook screenshots were inspected; the form has an explicit accessible Agent label and no horizontal page overflow.
Initial deployment attempts revealed a missing fixture COPY, a private CLI payload with the wrong UID, and an inaccessible select label. All were fixed before the final full passing run.
The aggregate deployment timeout increased from 900000 to 1200000 ms for the expanded composite; individual waits, production deadlines and native capacity limits are unchanged.

limitations: Generic bearer HTTPS protocol; vendor signature adapters and custom executable mappings are not implemented.
One bounded top-level text field; accepted means native admission, not execution success.
Recovery uses explicit source redelivery; no automatic delivery queue or exactly-once external-effect guarantee.
Verified with stock Qwen and deterministic test model, not corporate-fork authorization.
